Join us for an open Q&A session on Free Realms and the PlayStation 3 network. Bring all of your questions on cross-platform development, the challenges and opportunities! Presented by Ryan Wells.
Join panelists Tiffany Chu and Steve Bokkes and talk about the many live events in Free Relams - bring your questions!
SOE Artist and developer Floyd Bishop will be demonstrating how we animate characters in Free Realms and answering your questions about this critical phase of the development process.
Join us for an open Q&A session on Free Realms and the PlayStation 3 network. Bring all of your questions on cross-platform development, the challenges and opportunities! Presented by Ryan Wells.

Join Nick Parkinson, Chris Fritchoff, Eric Hankins and Steve Bokkes as they reveal how they use information collected in-game to evaluate Free Realms game features. How do they adapt and plan development to make Free Realms more fun? Bring your questions for the Q&A!

Find out where the fun in Free Realms comes from. Learn about the influence Community, Business, and Focus Testing have on the game. Brainstorm a new in-game item with developers! Last year's session brought a Beach Ball ride. What's this year's item going to be?
Free Realms: How the jackpot Plant Grew Into Farming

From Jackpot Plants to Farming, we'll discuss how simulation in Free Realms has taken on all new levels of depth, complexity, and most importantly, fun! Join the Free Realms Development Team to learn how the underlying system behind Farming will be used in upcoming features... like Ranching!

The Free Realms dev team chats directly with players about what goes into making Free Realms FUN! Got questions? Have some ideas? Bring them all! (Floyd Bishop; Ryan Shannon; Eric Hankins; Tiffany Spence)

In this popular panel, Floyd Bishop will again animate SOMETHING from start to finish, to show our workflow, processes and the behind-the-scenes stuff needed to make things move in game! (Floyd Bishop)

A discussion about animation with several experts from various SOE games, sharing their experiences on games like EverQuest, EverQuest II, Star Wars: Galaxies, DCUO, Free Realms, Clone Wars Adventures, and PlanetSide 2! Floyd promises that "This will be amazingly epic!" (Floyd Bishop, Tom Tobey, Chris Myers, Chad Lichty)
NEW THIS YEAR! Free Realms and Star Wars® Clone Wars Adventures Kids Zone!

Family-friendly and kid-approved activities, like the Free Realms Art Workshop, the Star Wars Clone Wars Adventures activities, including a kids' live quest, tasty treats and fun videos at the Afternoon Ice Cream Social, and prizes, goody bags and themed pictures to take home!

A discussion on the development and design involved with creating Sunstone Valley. This panel will cover the design goals chosen for Sunstone and what we wanted to accomplish for Free Realms as a whole. We'll also discuss the second expansion chunk, "Ponyvale" (name pending), while giving players a special sneak peek of the new zone. After the preview, we'll close with an audience participation segment to create a new Ponyvale themed item for the expansion and a short Q&A session. (Ryan Shannon; Eric Hankins)
